observed_problem: Core v2 release_identity built LONGFORM_SPECIAL tags directly from issue_id. Retrospective Period Profiles use internal issue IDs such as SP-2025-H2 while the established public Special identity is the survey slug 2025-H2 (for example tag special/2025-H2 and asset Japanese_Generative_AI_Technical_Survey_Special_2025-H2.pdf). The v2 path would therefore have produced special/SP-2025-H2 and an SP-prefixed asset/title for Period editions.
expected_behavior: Internal source issue identity and public publication slug must remain distinct where the repository already distinguishes them. Release identity/title/asset naming must derive from the authoritative Production Profile publication path/slug so Retrospective Period preserves established Special identities while stand-alone Thematic editions such as SP001 remain unchanged.
actual_behavior: scripts/survey_profiled_freeze_v2.py now derives the public issue slug from the exact Production Profile paths.survey_root basename and derives release identity from that slug plus publication_profile. Profile-aware Freeze/Manifest creation preserves the internal issue ID while writing the correct public tag. The release workflow rederives the same expected tag and public slug from the exact State-bound Production Profile, rejects Manifest divergence, and uses the public slug for title/asset naming. Regressions cover internal SP-2025-H2 -> public special/2025-H2 as well as unchanged SP001 and Weekly identities.

provenance.human_review_reference: Post-change five-perspective audit requested by Owner, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Separated internal issue identity from Profile-derived public publication slug and applied the public slug consistently to Freeze/Manifest/Release tag/title/asset authority.
